ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two blue oblique lines with the same inclined direction, and each oblique line has the same magenta arrow mark, indicating that these two oblique lines are parallel. There is also a steeper blue straight line as a transversal, intersecting these two parallel lines respectively. Near the upper intersection is marked the angle (2x − 15)°, and near the lower intersection is marked the angle (x + 55)°. Reasoning: Since the two oblique lines with the same arrow marks are parallel and are cut by the same transversal, the marked (2x − 15)° and (x + 55)° in the figure are a pair of corresponding equal angles of the type of corresponding angles or alternate interior angles. Therefore one can set 2x − 15 = x + 55. Solve the equation: 2x − x = 55 + 15, so x = 70.
